simple.meaning: מַזְמֵרָה (mazmêrâh) is a Hebrew word meaning “a pruning-knife.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מַזְמֵרָה (H4211) appears 4 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Isaiah 2:4, with occurrences in Isaiah, Joel, Micah.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מַזְמֵרָה (H4211) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מַזְמֵרָה (H4211) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מַזְמֵרָה (mazmêrâh) / H4211 is traced through Isaiah 2:4, Isaiah 18:5, Joel 4:10, Micah 4:3 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
